checkedAlternates.risk: Speed climbing uses an auto-belay rope.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Speed climbing is an Olympic standardized 15m sprint format (group-2), distinct from general roped rock climbing styles (group-3).
Waterfall ice climbing uses ice axes and crampons on vertical frozen water (group-1), whereas mountaineering spans glaciers and peaks (group-4).
